mapper.select: select d.id order_id,d.number order_number,s.name supplier_name,p.total_cents,d.approval_status, coalesce((select sum(rl.quantity_q4) from receipts r join receipt_lines rl on rl.receipt_id=r.document_id where r.order_id=d.id),0) received_quantity, coalesce((select sum(i.total_cents) from invoices i join documents idoc on idoc.id=i.document_id where i.order_id=d.id and idoc.approval_status='APPROVED'),0) approved_invoice_cents, coalesce((select sum(i.total_cents) from invoices i join documents idoc on idoc.id=i.document_id where i.order_id=d.id and idoc.approval_status='IN_REVIEW'),0) pending_invoice_cents from documents d join purchase_orders p on p.document_id=d.id join suppliers s on s.document_id=p.supplier_id where d.type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and d.deleted='0' and (d.creator_id=#{userId} or p.buyer_id=#{userId}exists(select 1 from sys_user cu where cu.user_id=d.creator_id and cu.dept_id=#{deptId} and cu.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from sys_user bu where bu.user_id=p.buyer_id and bu.dept_id=#{deptId} and bu.del_flag='0')) and d.number like concat('%',#{number},'%') and s.name like concat('%',#{supplierName},'%') and d.approval_status=#{approvalStatus} order by d.update_time desc
